description: Implement EmailBridge.capability_snapshot/1 and expose accurate SMTP and IMAP capabilities through the existing :channel_capability_snapshot endpoint. Reuse Bridge capability normalization and the existing BO capability display, wiring email BO screens consistently with other channels. Distinguish sending and receiving capabilities based on supported behavior; inspect existing email paths before declaring support. Do not add another capability endpoint. Exclude new file settings, TransportRequirements resolution, file acquisition, delivery planning, and execution changes. Action reuse assessment: extend the existing EmailBridge capability callback contract and reuse Channels.API, Bridge.capability_snapshot/2, and BO NodeRouter dispatch; no new Action or agent-tool exposure is needed for this read-only capability query. Use TDD with original tests: establish failing tests for SMTP/IMAP snapshots, endpoint normalization, and BO integration, then implement and run required checks. Do not copy tests from the old channel-files implementation or change existing test behavior without explicit approval. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/services/channels.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, and docs/testing-approach.md. Record exact capability decisions and validation results in this issue. This replaces the prematurely created unified-settings draft with the user-approved email capability foundation scope.

comments.text: Module-context evidence: EmailBridge owns IMAP ingress/lazy materialization and SMTP composition; SmtpSender.deliver_notification builds text/html/headers only, with no attachment path. ImapAdapter fetches selected body sections and lazy MIME attachment Records; Parser/threading helpers preserve RFC references. SMTP and IMAP both support text/threads; only IMAP supports receiving image/audio/video/file. Neither supports streaming, reactions, typing or edit_messages. Modes will identify smtp versus imap with send-only/receive-only labels. Capability declarations are static support, not enabled/configured readiness or SMTP reply-binding status. Contract owner: EmailBridge returns {:ok, %{resolved: ..., labels: ...}}; Bridge owns required/unsupported/default-label normalization; Api exposes existing :channel_capability_snapshot. BO requests provider scope via NodeRouter and renders ChannelCapabilities.icon_with_modal in existing page_tag slots. State: static snapshot/modal-open assigns per socket; connector settings remain Engine-owned. Invariants: no file sending claim, no connector lookup/credentials for provider scope, no sending/delivery/settings changes. Risks: ambiguous multi-connector lookup avoided by scope: :provider; unavailable Channels renders an empty snapshot. Existing tests prove composition/attachments/threading but lack email snapshots and modal wiring. Unknowns: no network/server capability probing is intended. Action reuse assessment: extend optional Bridge callback; reuse Bridge normalization, Api endpoint and BO display. No Action/tool exposure; BO dispatch helpers stay thin presentation glue. TDD: new async declaration/property tests, real endpoint integration tests, and LiveView modal/dispatch tests; preserve all existing test expectations. E2E authoring unnecessary: existing modal reused, no new journey or settings; LiveView tests cover the read-only display. Preserve zaq-h2i.1 files and .serena/project.yml. Previous stop of precommit will be honored; run mix q and targeted suites and record final precommit as not rerun per user direction.

Implementation and issue-level validation complete. IMAP: text/image/audio/video/file/threads=true, streaming/reactions/typing/edit_messages=false, mode=imap with receive-only mode/media labels. No browser tool available for interactive inspection; shared component/Storybook contract preserved and rendered modal behavior proven by LiveView tests. No new E2E authored: this read-only use of the existing modal is covered by smaller tests. Logs: /tmp/zaq-h2i-2-{red,green,q,regression}.log. Pre-existing .serena/project.yml and zaq-h2i.1 struct/tests preserved. No commit or push; issue remains in progress pending review/landing.

Scope correction from latest user instruction: do not change Jido/Mattermost capabilities, adapters or their existing tests, and do not extend the shared contract without first explaining its gap. Review findings: Jido.Chat.Capabilities.channel_capabilities/1 explicitly provides delivery-focused capabilities. JidoChatBridge resolves supported features to :native/:fallback (omitting unsupported entries), and resolved.mode describes ingress mechanism (websocket/gateway/polling/webhook), not provider identity or send/receive direction. Bridge supplies common labels and detects unsupported fields; Api forwards the existing endpoint request; BO renders the common labels/statuses without interpreting provider identity. Prior email implementation violates this by mixing booleans with Jido support statuses, claiming received IMAP media as outbound delivery, setting modes to protocol names, and encoding direction in labels. Shared-contract gap: no independent receive-capability dimension; IMAP attachment reception cannot be reported as file delivery. An email-only correction can preserve the contract by reporting outbound text/thread support (IMAP-origin replies use selected/sole SMTP), omitting unsupported media/streaming/reactions/typing/edit_messages, using ingress mode strings none for SMTP and idle for IMAP, and relying entirely on shared labels. These mode strings keep existing ingress-mechanism semantics; no enum is enforced by Bridge or BO. No shared-contract, adapter, endpoint, normalization or display-component change is proposed. Existing email test expectations assert the superseded booleans/receiving media/protocol mode/direction labels; approval is required before updating them under docs/testing-approach.md#existing-test-behavior-approval-gate. Preparing original regression tests for the defects before that approval; no production or existing test edits yet. Issue 1 SHA-256 values unchanged; mix precommit remains prohibited.

Human approval received in the current conversation: user selected Approve email-only correction and test updates. Approved scope: change only email capability expectations from booleans to :native text/threads, omit unsupported media/features, modes none (SMTP) and idle (IMAP), and use common labels without direction-bearing text. IMAP outbound text/threads refer to existing replies via SMTP binding. Approval covers test/zaq/channels/email_capabilities_test.exs and test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/email_capabilities_live_test.exs. Jido/Mattermost, adapters, their tests, shared normalization/endpoint/display remain unchanged. Original new regression suite added; corrected its HTML parser to the installed LazyHTML dependency before confirming a clean missing-correction TDD baseline.

Clean original-regression TDD red verified before implementing the correction: all 7 tests failed solely for booleans versus :native, IMAP media delivery claims, custom labels, or protocol-name modes; HTML parser harness issues resolved. Existing email test expectations are now updated within the explicit approved scope; production code is still unchanged at this checkpoint. Red log: /tmp/zaq-h2i-2-correction-red.log.
